name: @snapping-turtle/extension
description: MV3 browser extension: one codebase, Chrome (service worker) and Firefox (event page) builds

scripts.build:chrome: pnpm run shared && tsx scripts/build.ts chrome
scripts.build:firefox: pnpm run shared && tsx scripts/build.ts firefox
scripts.listing-shots: pnpm run shared && pnpm --filter @snapping-turtle/web build && pnpm build:chrome && tsx scripts/listing-shots.ts
